meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Statistical Tables Relating to Banks in India
meta.coverage: Loans restructured, including corporate debt restructuring, bank by bank, each year
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1058 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Final figures where published, else provisional. Amounts in ₹ crore; counts as numbers; ratios in per cent, as each row's label says. The table's headings say ₹ lakh; the values are rupees (State Bank of India's restructured doubtful assets ₹2,417 crore), shown in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Nationalised banks, Corporation bank, Loans Subjected to Restructuring, Sub-Standard Assets during the Year on 2007-03-01; Old private sector banks, Nainital bank ltd, Loans Subjected to Restructuring, Doubtful Assets during the Year on 2014-03-01).
